text_block_list.text:
After my time in the Twinkle Series――I was 
honored to be selected for the URA's 
overseas study program, and set foot in 
Paris.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
You've arrived quite early. The training 
doesn't start until tomorrow, you know?
choice_data_list: I thought I'd learn more about Paris.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
A fine attitude! Understanding local 
culture makes a world of difference in how 
deeply one learns.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Seeing it in VR versus experiencing it in 
real life is bound to feel completely 
different……

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Hmm, that's true—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
For the whole day—this time in person, I 
will guide you through Paris!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Why, of course! I've been wanting to take 
a stroll around this town again after so 
long. There were things I couldn't fully 
introduce during the VR tour, too.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Just think of it as getting dragged along 
on my trip back home!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's grab some lunch right 
away! You must be starving after that long 
flight, right?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Now, what are you in the mood to eat? This 
is Paris, capital of fine cuisine! Duck 
confit, sole meunière... There's a 
mountain of delicious things to choose 
from!

Since I'm with Mei Satake, who grew up 
here, I want to learn as much as I can 
about Paris's "everyday life."

With that— I gestured with an open palm 
toward a sandwich a passerby was happily 
munching on.
choice_data_list:
I want to eat what the locals in Paris 
eat.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Oh, the ham sandwich?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
That's basically like going to Japan as a 
tourist and eating a rice ball――ah, so 
that's why.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
You're quite diligent, aren't you? You're 
genuinely trying to learn all about Paris.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! In that case, I know a spot 
I've been going to since I was a kid. 
Follow me!

A cafe with a chic ambiance. Even the 
cursive script on the menu looked like a 
work of artââ

The idiosyncratic cursive script is 
difficult to decipher. Despite being 
selected for overseas training, this is 
quite embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
They have an English and Japanese menu 
over here. Plus, the staff here speak 
Japanese, too.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Paris has always been a diverse city. Take 
your time, don't rush, and settle in 
slowly.
choice_data_list:
W-Well then, I'll go with this ham 
sandwich!

text_block_list.name: Japanese-Speaking Clerk
text_block_list.text: Thanks as always for your business~!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Your Japanese has improved again, Boss. 
How's business treating you?

text_block_list.name: Japanese-Speaking Clerk
text_block_list.text: Aha, so-so, I see!

While Mei Satake chatted leisurely with 
the familiar shopkeeper, the savory aroma 
of a ham sandwich wafted over.

After savoring a ham sandwich made with 
fresh ham, artisanal butter, and a crisp, 
fragrant baguette――

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
When I asked where you wanted to go next, 
you immediately brought us here right 
after eating. Your workaholism is truly on 
another level.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...No matter how many times I come here, 
the atmosphere is always completely 
different from racetracks in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
It feels so solemn and invigorating. 
Though I do love Japanese racetracks, too.

Though we had stopped by the racetrack 
without any prior plan, it turned into an 
unforgettable experience.

A profound aura fitting for the global 
stage. A proving ground where dreams and 
romance bloom and wither. Umamusume 
shouldering the expectations of their 
nations.
choice_data_list: Winning here really must be tough, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. Winning is hard enough, but 
continuing to win is far harder.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
A dream is out of reach by definition. But 
once you grasp it, it becomes reality. And 
then, you chase after a new one.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: That is what it means to keep on winning.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Now then, there's a sight I'd love for you 
to see. ...Come with me. To that famous 
spot.

On the western edge of the Avenue des 
Champs-Élysées, often hailed as the most 
beautiful avenue in the world――
choice_data_list: So this is *the* Arc de Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yes, when speaking of the Arc de Triomphe, 
it's *this* Arc de Triomphe. Though there 
are actually others, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yet, this is the one everyone imagines. 
Its true name is the Arc de Triomphe de 
l'Étoile.

Arc de triomphe de l'Étoile. Literally 
translated, it means "Triumphal Arch of 
the Star."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Stars are out of reach. So we bestow that 
name upon the gate the victor passes 
through. Isn't that romantic?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps reasons like that are why this Arc 
de Triomphe is beloved all across the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
That Arc de Triomphe stands along a line 
known as the historical axis of Paris.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
There are many Arcs de Triomphe out there. 
Just as there are many dreams along the 
road of life.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Which other one would you like to pass 
under?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! What a selfish little punk! Just 
like the old me!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Very well! Today, and tomorrow as well, I 
shall accompany you to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
And one day, may you pass beneath your 
very own Arc de Triomphe among the stars!
